newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer across the board on Wednesday, lifted by short-covering in a corrective move after falls during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.7 yen per kg up than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.1 yen up at 134.9 yen.

During the day, prices drifted lower. Activity was mainly dominated by position-adjustment trade ahead of the spot expiry on Friday. "The spot October contract was especially weak before the expiry. But further falls could be limited, supported by rains in producing countries and the yen's weaker tendency," one trader said.
